home-content: I'm Gabriel Raiol, an IT Advisor with experience in IT strategy, project management, IT governance, and digital transformation. I also build web applications using React and TypeScript, bridging business needs and software engineering to deliver scalable, high-value solutions.
rodape: There is nothing permanent except change
about-content: Graduated in Information Systems from UFRA, I have worked with IT infrastructure consulting and analysis, performing requirements gathering, system implementation, deployment, and user support. I participated in a digital transformation project in the public healthcare sector in a municipality in the state of Pará, leading the implementation of an Electronic Health Record (EHR) system. With 9 years of experience in Information Technology, I currently serve as an IT Advisor in the public sector, providing direct advisory support to the board and executive leadership. My role focuses on continuously identifying and applying technological solutions to improve business processes and operational efficiency. In addition to being passionate about technology and innovation, I enjoy cycling, strength training, and the gaming environment as personal hobbies. 😄
experience-content-5:
• Responsible for the strategic planning of hardware, software, and service acquisitions, as well as managing the organization's technology infrastructure. Acts as a key stakeholder in technology contracts, ensuring that vendor deliverables are aligned with the goals and expectations of the board and executive leadership;

  • Leads the analysis and restructuring of processes related to technology, proposing solutions to enhance operational efficiency. Defines guidelines, sets priorities, and ensures that corporate systems are aligned with the institution's strategic needs;

  • Provides direct advisory support to the board and executive leadership, preparing technical reports, managing project roadmaps, and supporting decision-making in areas related to digital transformation, innovation, and process optimization.
